summary: Copy the signed host-runner run records (record.json) of task V3-008 from the host-run store into an agent-readable directory

investigation.blocked_claim: The held-out TD-H/TL-H grades (amendment R2-STOP3) must bind every ionmc sample chunk to a complete host-runner-signed run record verified against the committed trust file; without the complete records the signature cannot be re-verified from the repository (Codex REVIEW-2f0b4eec finding 1, important).
investigation.budget: no compute; one file copy by the operator (about 110-130 JSON files of a few KB); the evaluator change and its tests are being implemented in parallel and are blocked only on the files
investigation.alternatives: (1) Re-running the 13 held-out chunks to capture complete records: rejected, it would break the pre-registered order (samples sealed before the TOPAS runs, which have already happened) and consume seeds. (2) Binding only the attestation block already in the seal: insufficient, the signature covers the full payload which is not in the seal. (3) Reading the session transcript or the host-run store from the agent: both directories are denied to the agent sandbox.

attempts.approach: read the host-run store ~/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/experiment-v3/host-runs from the agent sandbox
attempts.outcome: not visible/denied (only tmp, telemetry, claude-memory under experiment-v3 are readable)

attempts.approach: verify the orchestrator's run-time captures (scratchpad/v3-008/chunks-heldout/result-case*-k*.json) with attest.verify_record
attempts.outcome: payload hash mismatch: the captures hold only a subset of the signed fields, so they cannot replace the complete records

attempts.approach: reproduce the signed output_manifest_sha256 from the published files under validation/generated/<run_id>/
attempts.outcome: reproduced for the first three held-out chunks (sorted 'validation/generated/<relpath>\0<sha256>\n' lines), so the npz binding works once the complete records are available
attempts.artifact: python check in this session against sample-seal-heldout-r2stop3.json chunks k1-k3 of case 10

investigation.host_run_root: infrastructure/host_runner/host_runner.py: RUN_ROOT = SHARE_ROOT / 'host-runs'; record written to run_dir/record.json (write_json) after sign_with_service_key(result, 'host-runner')
investigation.mcp_return: infrastructure/mcp/host_runner_mcp.py returns json.loads(runner stdout) = the complete signed record (returned once at run time)
investigation.needed_run_ids: the 13 host_runs of sample-seal-heldout-r2stop3.json (RUN-20261111T032108Z-0f2c091b ... RUN-20261111T072739Z-2ca81843) and the 76 host_runs of sample-seal.json; copying all V3-008 records is simpler and also archives the A-row runs

reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: Codex REVIEW-2f0b4eec (commit 55e6a180, finding "important") requires the held-out grader (validation/scripts/ion_em/r2_io.py) to verify each ionmc sample chunk's COMPLETE signed host-run record with the committed host-runner key (key_id 4d02f521f3fb9344) and to bind run id, git SHA, output-manifest digest and the NPZ output to the seal. The sample seals (validation/results/transport/v8r2-samples/sample-seal.json, 76 runs; sample-seal-heldout-r2stop3.json, 13 runs) carry only the attestation block and a few fields of each record, not the full signed payload, so the signature cannot be re-verified from the repository. The complete records are written by the host runner as <RUN_ROOT>/V3-008/<run_id>/record.json where RUN_ROOT = ~/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/experiment-v3/host-runs (infrastructure/host_runner/host_runner.py, create_run_dir / write_json). That directory is outside the agent sandbox's readable paths (only ~/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/experiment-v3/{tmp,telemetry,claude-memory} are readable) and no MCP tool exposes stored host-run records; the records were returned once by run_host_validation at run time and my captures kept only a subset of fields. No simulation is re-run; the records are untrusted data until the evaluator verifies the Ed25519 signatures against the committed trust file, so a plain file copy is sufficient and no interpretation is needed.
requested_input:
Please run the following command on the host (as the experiment user) and resolve this request with the number of files it copied (no other input needed):

DEST=/home/wahln/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/experiment-v3/tmp/claude-1000/-home-wahln-aiprojects-ion-mc/7253bd60-c1c4-4639-87ca-be1d01b37b4f/scratchpad/v3-008/host-records
SRC=/home/wahln/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/experiment-v3/host-runs/V3-008
mkdir -p "$DEST" && n=0; for f in "$SRC"/RUN-*/record.json; do cp -p "$f" "$DEST/$(basename "$(dirname "$f")").json" && n=$((n+1)); done; echo "copied $n"; ls "$DEST" | wc -l

This copies every V3-008 host-run record (all RUN-* directories; roughly 110–130 files, a few KB each) verbatim as <run_id>.json into the agent-readable scratchpad directory. If the host-run root differs on your machine (e.g. ~/.local/share/ionmc-experiment/host-runs/V3-008), adjust SRC accordingly. Nothing else is required; please do not edit the files.
